description: This file defines configuration structures and functions related to the Cuttlefish Android emulator, including guest configuration and initialization functions.

classes.name: GuestConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a guest virtual device in Cuttlefish, including architecture, device type, supported features, and optional custom configurations.

methods.name: GetGuestConfigAndSetDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves a list of guest configurations with default settings applied.

methods.name: InitializeCuttlefishConfiguration
methods.description: Initializes the Cuttlefish configuration based on root directory, guest configs, injector, and fetcher configuration.

methods.name: GetConfigFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the Cuttlefish configuration file.

methods.name: GetSeccompPolicyDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for seccomp policies.
